notes.C01: Two-witness seam detector with a synthetic tamper bench gives fact-check and crashed-demo answers; hum/ENF witness is shaky on phone reels.
notes.C02: Fresh 'recorded vs laid on vs generated' verdict per voice, but leans on native-rate/stereo reads the 16 kHz mono pipeline does not keep.
notes.C03: Inverting forensics into a pass/fail spec for the owner's real Vietnamese re-voice job, with the original as a free answer key, is the sharpest idea here.
notes.C04: Speaker-relative pace and pause deviations reuse data already computed and avoid the rejected emotion labels; useful but incremental.
notes.C05: Word-anchored deixis window targets the bench's only shared miss and starts with a cheap premise check; low novelty, high payoff per cost.
notes.C06: Pointer/click ledger plus run-to-run diff serves bug repros, and the agent recording its own UI work makes an exact key.
notes.C07: Caret/pointer-stop crops fit the 20 fast-cut code zooms and first-frame OCR fixes a real blind spot for static claim banners; cheap and directly evidenced.
notes.C08: A card that survives truncation is a real delivery fix; segment log and trim ladder are standard radio ideas, and SponsorBlock adds a network dependency.
notes.C09: Checking the agent's own media deliverables against known intent targets the owner's actual pain with exact keys and a canary judge.
notes.C10: Repeat/copy detection and clip-to-source edit lists are solid, but few logged use cases ask for them.
notes.C11: A 'Blind:' ledger stops a silent card reading as 'nothing there', and an ablation judge makes it testable; the provenance header adds per-card tokens.
notes.C12: A sound process for choosing senses from real corrections, but it is meta-method more than a new sense.
notes.C13: Clever 'absence of mess' signal for assembled dialogue, but narrow demand in the logged uses.
notes.C14: Concrete, grounded in a real owner moment, but open-vocabulary image matching is close to the CLAP path already rejected for music.
notes.C15: Foley-style contact-sound binding is inventive but needs stereo and an unbuilt contact event for a niche question.
